abbott_smith_html:
πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν, genitive, παντός, πάσης, παντός,
[in LXX chiefly for כֹּל ;]
all, every.
__I. As adj.,
__1. with subst. anarth., all, every, of every kind: Mat.3:10 4:23, Mrk.9:49, Luk.4:37, Jhn.2:1o, Act.27:20, Rom.7:8, Rev.18:17, al. mult.; pl., all, Act.22:15, Rom.5:12, Heb.1:6, al.; of the highest degree, π. ἐξουσία (προθυμία, χαρά), Mat.28:18, Act.17:11, Phi 2:29, al.; also the whole (though in this sense more frequently with art.), Mat.2:3, Act.2:36, Rom.11:26.
__2. C. art. (before the art., after the noun, or, denoting totality, between the art. and noun), all, whole: Mat.8:32 13:2, Mrk.5:33, Luk.1:10, Act.7:14, Rom.3:19, Gal.5:14, Eph.4:16, al.; pl., Mat.2:4, Mrk.4:13, Rom.1:5, al.
__II. As pron.,
__1. masc. and fem., every one: Mrk.9:49, Luk.16:16, Heb.2:9; before rel. pron., Mat.7:24, Act.2:21, Gal.3:10, al.; with ptcp. (anarth.), Mat.13:19, Luk.11:4; with ptcp. (with art.), Mat.5:22, Mrk.7:8, Luk.6:47, Jhn.3:8, Rom.1:16, al.; pl., πάντες, absol., all, all men, Mat.10:22, Mrk.13:13, Luk.20:38, Jhn.1:7 3:26, 1Co.8:1, al.; οἱ π. (collectively, as a definite whole), Rom.11:32, 1Co.1:17, Eph.4:13, al.; π. οἱ (ὅσοι), Mat.4:24, Mrk.1:32, Luk.4:40, al.
__2. Neut.,
__(a) sing., πᾶν, everything, all: πᾶν τό, with ptcp., 1Co.10:25, 27, Eph.5:13, 1Jn.2:16 5:4 (sc. ὄν); πᾶν ὅ, Jhn.17:2, Rom.14:23; collectively, of persons (Westc., in l.), Jhn.6:37, 39; with prep., in adverbial phrases, διὰ παντός, always, Mat.18:10, al.; ἐν παντί, in everything, in every way, 2Co.4:8, Phi 4:6, al.;
__(b) pl., πάτνα, all things: absol., Jhn.1:3, 1Co.2:10, Heb.2:8, al.; of certain specified things, Mrk.4:34, Luk.1:3, Rom.8:28, 1Th.5:21, al.; accusative, πάντα, adverbially, wholly, in all things, in all respects, Act.20:35, 1Co.9:25, al.; with art., τὰ π., all things (a totality, as distinct from anarth. πάντα, all things severally; cf. Westc, Eph., 186f.), absol.: Rom.11:36, 1Co.8:6, Eph.3:9, Heb.1:3, al.; relatively, Mrk.4:11, Act.17:25, Rom.8:32, al.; πάντα, with ptcp., Mat.18:31, al.; πάντα ταῦτα (ταῦτα π.), Mat.6:32, 33, al.; πάντα, with prep, in adverbial phrases, πρὸ πάντων, above all things, Jas.5:12, 1Pe.4:8; ἐν π́, in all things, in all ways, 1Ti.3:11, 1Pe.4:11, al.; κατὰ πάντα, in all respects, Act.17:22, al.
__3. C. neg., πᾶς οὐ (μή) = οὐδείς, see: οὐ and μή, and cf. M, Pr., 245f.
(AS)

occurrences.bsb: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

occurrences.bsb: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
occurrences.kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

occurrences.bsb: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

occurrences.bsb: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
occurrences.kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

occurrences.bsb: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
occurrences.kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judea, and all the region round about Jordan,

occurrences.bsb: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
occurrences.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

occurrences.bsb: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
occurrences.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

occurrences.bsb: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

occurrences.bsb: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
occurrences.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

occurrences.bsb: News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and He healed them.
occurrences.kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

occurrences.bsb: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
occurrences.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

occurrences.bsb: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
occurrences.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

occurrences.bsb: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
occurrences.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

occurrences.bsb: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
occurrences.kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

occurrences.bsb: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
occurrences.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

occurrences.bsb: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
occurrences.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

occurrences.bsb: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
occurrences.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

occurrences.bsb: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
occurrences.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

occurrences.bsb: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

occurrences.bsb: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
occurrences.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

occurrences.bsb: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
occurrences.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

occurrences.bsb: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

occurrences.bsb: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
occurrences.kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

occurrences.bsb: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

occurrences.bsb: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

occurrences.bsb: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
occurrences.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
occurrences.kjv: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
occurrences.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

occurrences.bsb: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
occurrences.kjv: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

occurrences.bsb: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
occurrences.kjv: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

occurrences.bsb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

occurrences.bsb: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
occurrences.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

occurrences.bsb: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
occurrences.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

occurrences.bsb: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
occurrences.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
occurrences.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

occurrences.bsb: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
occurrences.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

occurrences.bsb: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

occurrences.bsb: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
occurrences.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

occurrences.bsb: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

occurrences.bsb: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

occurrences.bsb: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
occurrences.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

occurrences.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
occurrences.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

occurrences.bsb: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
occurrences.kjv: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
occurrences.kjv: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

occurrences.bsb: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?
occurrences.kjv: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

occurrences.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
occurrences.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

occurrences.bsb: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
occurrences.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

occurrences.bsb: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
occurrences.kjv: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

occurrences.bsb: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
occurrences.kjv: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

occurrences.bsb: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.
occurrences.kjv: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

occurrences.bsb: Then the master summoned him and said, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
occurrences.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

occurrences.bsb: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.
occurrences.kjv: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

occurrences.bsb: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
occurrences.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

occurrences.bsb: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
occurrences.kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

occurrences.bsb: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
occurrences.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

occurrences.bsb: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
occurrences.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

occurrences.bsb: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
occurrences.kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

occurrences.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
occurrences.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
occurrences.kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

occurrences.bsb: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
occurrences.kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

occurrences.bsb: And last of all, the woman died.
occurrences.kjv: And last of all the woman died also.

occurrences.bsb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

occurrences.bsb: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
occurrences.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

occurrences.bsb: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
occurrences.kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

occurrences.bsb: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
occurrences.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

occurrences.bsb: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
occurrences.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.

occurrences.bsb: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
occurrences.kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

occurrences.bsb: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

occurrences.bsb: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
occurrences.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

occurrences.bsb: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.

occurrences.bsb: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”

occurrences.bsb: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region.

occurrences.bsb: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

occurrences.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

occurrences.bsb: and Levi got up, left everything, and followed Him.

occurrences.bsb: The entire crowd was trying to touch Him, because power was coming from Him and healing them all.
occurrences.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

occurrences.bsb: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what is yours, do not demand it back.
occurrences.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

occurrences.bsb: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.

occurrences.bsb: I will show you what he is like who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them:

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus had concluded His discourse in the hearing of the people, He went to Capernaum.
occurrences.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

occurrences.bsb: A sense of awe swept over all of them, and they glorified God. “A great prophet has appeared among us!” they said. “God has visited His people!”
occurrences.kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

occurrences.bsb: And the news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and all the surrounding region.
occurrences.kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judea, and throughout all the region round about.

occurrences.bsb: Then John’s disciples informed him about all these things.
occurrences.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

occurrences.kjv: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

occurrences.bsb: But wisdom is vindicated by all her children.”
occurrences.kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

occurrences.bsb: Then the woman, seeing that she could not escape notice, came trembling and fell down before Him. In the presence of all the people, she explained why she had touched Him and how she had immediately been healed.
occurrences.kjv: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile, everyone was weeping and mourning for her. But Jesus said, “Stop weeping; she is not dead but asleep.”
occurrences.kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases.
occurrences.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
occurrences.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

occurrences.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
occurrences.kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
occurrences.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing, He said to His disciples,

occurrences.bsb: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

occurrences.bsb: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him to every town and place He was about to visit.
occurrences.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation.’”
occurrences.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

occurrences.bsb: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
occurrences.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

occurrences.bsb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.
occurrences.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

occurrences.bsb: But give as alms the things that are within you, and behold, everything will be clean for you.
occurrences.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to you Pharisees! For you pay tithes of mint, rue, and every herb, but you disregard justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former.
occurrences.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

occurrences.bsb: As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,
occurrences.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

occurrences.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
occurrences.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, everyone who confesses Me before men, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God.
occurrences.kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

occurrences.bsb: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

occurrences.bsb: Then he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones, and there I will store up all my grain and my goods.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

occurrences.bsb: Consider how the lilies grow: They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
occurrences.kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

occurrences.bsb: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
occurrences.kjv: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

occurrences.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
occurrences.kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
occurrences.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

occurrences.bsb: To this He replied, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this way?

occurrences.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

occurrences.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”
occurrences.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

occurrences.bsb: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”

occurrences.bsb: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that I acquire.’

occurrences.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

occurrences.bsb: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”
occurrences.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

occurrences.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

occurrences.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.

occurrences.bsb: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
occurrences.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.

occurrences.bsb: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
occurrences.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

occurrences.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

occurrences.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

occurrences.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

occurrences.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

occurrences.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

occurrences.bsb: And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
occurrences.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

occurrences.bsb: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
occurrences.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

occurrences.bsb: “What things?” He asked. “The events involving Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. “This man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

occurrences.bsb: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
occurrences.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

occurrences.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

occurrences.bsb: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
occurrences.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

occurrences.bsb: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: praising God continually in the temple.
occurrences.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
occurrences.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

occurrences.bsb: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
occurrences.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

occurrences.bsb: The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
occurrences.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

occurrences.bsb: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
occurrences.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

occurrences.bsb: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
occurrences.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

occurrences.bsb: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

occurrences.bsb: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
occurrences.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
occurrences.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

occurrences.bsb: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

occurrences.bsb: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
occurrences.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

occurrences.bsb: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
occurrences.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

occurrences.bsb: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
occurrences.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

occurrences.bsb: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
occurrences.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

occurrences.bsb: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
occurrences.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

occurrences.bsb: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
occurrences.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
occurrences.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

occurrences.bsb: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
occurrences.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

occurrences.bsb: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
occurrences.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

occurrences.bsb: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
occurrences.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

occurrences.bsb: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
occurrences.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
occurrences.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

occurrences.bsb: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
occurrences.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

occurrences.bsb: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
occurrences.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

occurrences.bsb: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
occurrences.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

occurrences.bsb: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
occurrences.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

occurrences.bsb: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
occurrences.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

occurrences.bsb: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
occurrences.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

occurrences.bsb: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
occurrences.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

occurrences.bsb: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

occurrences.bsb: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
occurrences.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

occurrences.bsb: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
occurrences.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

occurrences.bsb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
occurrences.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

occurrences.bsb: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
occurrences.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

occurrences.bsb: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.
occurrences.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

occurrences.bsb: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
occurrences.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

occurrences.bsb: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
occurrences.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

occurrences.bsb: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

occurrences.bsb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
occurrences.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
occurrences.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

occurrences.bsb: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
occurrences.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

occurrences.bsb: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
occurrences.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

occurrences.bsb: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
occurrences.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

occurrences.bsb: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

occurrences.bsb: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

occurrences.bsb: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
occurrences.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

occurrences.bsb: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
occurrences.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
occurrences.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
occurrences.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

occurrences.bsb: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
occurrences.kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

occurrences.bsb: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

occurrences.bsb: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
occurrences.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

occurrences.bsb: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
occurrences.kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

occurrences.bsb: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
occurrences.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

occurrences.bsb: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
occurrences.kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

occurrences.bsb: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
occurrences.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

occurrences.bsb: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
occurrences.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

occurrences.bsb: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
occurrences.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

occurrences.bsb: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

occurrences.bsb: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
occurrences.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

occurrences.bsb: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
occurrences.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

occurrences.bsb: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
occurrences.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

occurrences.bsb: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.
occurrences.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

occurrences.bsb: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
occurrences.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

occurrences.bsb: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
occurrences.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

occurrences.bsb: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
occurrences.kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

occurrences.bsb: While the man clung to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade.
occurrences.kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

occurrences.bsb: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
occurrences.kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

occurrences.bsb: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
occurrences.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
occurrences.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

occurrences.bsb: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
occurrences.kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people.’
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

occurrences.bsb: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

occurrences.bsb: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
occurrences.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

occurrences.bsb: “What shall we do with these men?” they asked. “It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them, and we cannot deny it.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

occurrences.bsb: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.
occurrences.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

occurrences.bsb: When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
occurrences.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

occurrences.bsb: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
occurrences.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

occurrences.bsb: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
occurrences.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

occurrences.bsb: On hearing these words, Ananias fell down and died. And great fear came over all who heard what had happened.
occurrences.kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

occurrences.bsb: And great fear came over the whole church and all who heard about these events.
occurrences.kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

occurrences.bsb: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
occurrences.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

occurrences.bsb: “Go, stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life.”
occurrences.kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

occurrences.bsb: At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
occurrences.kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

occurrences.bsb: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

occurrences.bsb: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a short time.
occurrences.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

occurrences.bsb: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men joined him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
occurrences.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

occurrences.bsb: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away people after him. He too perished, and all his followers were scattered.
occurrences.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

occurrences.bsb: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.

occurrences.kjv: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

occurrences.bsb: Surely all the Jews know how I have lived from my earliest childhood among my own people, and also in Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;

occurrences.bsb: I frequently had them punished in the synagogues, and I tried to make them blaspheme. In my raging fury against them, I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.
occurrences.kjv: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.

occurrences.bsb: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice say to me in Hebrew, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
occurrences.kjv: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

occurrences.bsb: First to those in Damascus and Jerusalem, then to everyone in the region of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, I declared that they should repent and turn to God, performing deeds worthy of their repentance.
occurrences.kjv: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

occurrences.bsb: “Short time or long,” Paul replied, “I wish to God that not only you but all who hear me this day may become what I am, except for these chains.”
occurrences.kjv: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

occurrences.bsb: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the great storm continued to batter us, we abandoned all hope of being saved.
occurrences.kjv: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.

occurrences.bsb: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul; you must stand before Caesar. And look, God has granted you the lives of all who sail with you.’
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Cesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

occurrences.bsb: After he had said this, Paul took bread and gave thanks to God in front of them all. Then he broke it and began to eat.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.

occurrences.bsb: They were all encouraged and took some food themselves.
occurrences.kjv: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.

occurrences.bsb: In all, there were 276 of us on board.
occurrences.kjv: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

occurrences.bsb: The rest were to follow on planks and various parts of the ship. In this way everyone was brought safely to land.
occurrences.kjv: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

occurrences.bsb: The islanders showed us extraordinary kindness. They kindled a fire and welcomed all of us because it was raining and cold.
occurrences.kjv: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

occurrences.bsb: Paul stayed there two full years in his own rented house, welcoming all who came to visit him.
occurrences.kjv: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,

occurrences.bsb: Boldly and freely he proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.

occurrences.bsb: Through Him and on behalf of His name, we received grace and apostleship to call all those among the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith.
occurrences.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

occurrences.bsb: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed all over the world.
occurrences.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

occurrences.bsb: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
