occurrences.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

occurrences.bsb: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

occurrences.bsb: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed, and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice. They are gossips,
occurrences.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

occurrences.bsb: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another. For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

occurrences.bsb: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil, first for the Jew, then for the Greek;
occurrences.kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

occurrences.bsb: but glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.
occurrences.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

occurrences.bsb: Much in every way. First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.
occurrences.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

occurrences.bsb: Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”
occurrences.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

occurrences.bsb: What then? Are we any better? Not at all. For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin.
occurrences.kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

occurrences.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”
occurrences.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

occurrences.bsb: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
occurrences.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

occurrences.bsb: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,
occurrences.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

occurrences.bsb: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
occurrences.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

occurrences.bsb: And he received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but are not circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.
occurrences.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may rest on grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

occurrences.bsb: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

occurrences.bsb: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
occurrences.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

occurrences.bsb: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
occurrences.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

occurrences.bsb: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
occurrences.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

occurrences.bsb: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
occurrences.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

occurrences.bsb: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: It is not as though God’s word has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

occurrences.bsb: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants are they all his children. On the contrary, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
occurrences.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

occurrences.bsb: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: “I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display My power in you, and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
occurrences.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

occurrences.bsb: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
occurrences.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on Him,
occurrences.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

occurrences.bsb: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

occurrences.bsb: But not all of them welcomed the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message?”
occurrences.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

occurrences.bsb: But I ask, did they not hear? Indeed they did: “Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
occurrences.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

occurrences.bsb: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.”
occurrences.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

occurrences.bsb: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
occurrences.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

occurrences.bsb: For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

occurrences.bsb: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
occurrences.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

occurrences.bsb: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
occurrences.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

occurrences.bsb: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
occurrences.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

occurrences.bsb: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
occurrences.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
occurrences.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

occurrences.bsb: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
occurrences.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

occurrences.bsb: For one person has faith to eat all things, while another, who is weak, eats only vegetables.
occurrences.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

occurrences.bsb: One person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
occurrences.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

occurrences.bsb: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
occurrences.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: It is written: “As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow before Me; every tongue will confess to God.”
occurrences.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

occurrences.bsb: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to let his eating be a stumbling block.
occurrences.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
occurrences.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

occurrences.bsb: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: I myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, brimming with knowledge, and able to instruct one another.
occurrences.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

occurrences.bsb: The God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: who have risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.
occurrences.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
occurrences.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

occurrences.bsb: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
occurrences.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
occurrences.kjv: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

occurrences.bsb: For in Him you have been enriched in every way, in all speech and all knowledge,
occurrences.kjv: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;

occurrences.bsb: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
occurrences.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

occurrences.bsb: so that no one may boast in His presence.
occurrences.kjv: That no flesh should glory in his presence.

occurrences.bsb: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
occurrences.kjv: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.

occurrences.bsb: The spiritual man judges all things, but he himself is not subject to anyone’s judgment.
occurrences.kjv: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, stop boasting in men. All things are yours,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;

occurrences.bsb: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future. All of them belong to you,
occurrences.kjv: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

occurrences.bsb: when we are slandered, we answer gently. Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

occurrences.bsb: “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible for me,” but I will not be mastered by anything.
occurrences.kjv: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.

occurrences.bsb: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
occurrences.kjv: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
occurrences.kjv: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.

occurrences.bsb: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
occurrences.kjv: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.

occurrences.bsb: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
occurrences.kjv: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

occurrences.bsb: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
occurrences.kjv: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

occurrences.bsb: But not everyone has this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

occurrences.bsb: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
occurrences.kjv: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

occurrences.bsb: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.
occurrences.kjv: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

occurrences.bsb: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings.
occurrences.kjv: And this I do for the gospel’s sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
occurrences.kjv: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

occurrences.bsb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

occurrences.bsb: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

occurrences.bsb: They all ate the same spiritual food
occurrences.kjv: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

occurrences.bsb: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
occurrences.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

occurrences.bsb: “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is edifying.
occurrences.kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

occurrences.bsb: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
occurrences.kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

occurrences.bsb: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
occurrences.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

occurrences.bsb: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: as I also try to please everyone in all I do. For I am not seeking my own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved.
occurrences.kjv: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

occurrences.bsb: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
occurrences.kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.

occurrences.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

occurrences.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
occurrences.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

occurrences.bsb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
occurrences.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

occurrences.bsb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
occurrences.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

occurrences.bsb: There are different ways of working, but the same God works all things in all people.
occurrences.kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

occurrences.bsb: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.
occurrences.kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

occurrences.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
occurrences.kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
occurrences.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

occurrences.bsb: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
occurrences.kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

occurrences.bsb: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
occurrences.kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

occurrences.bsb: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
occurrences.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

occurrences.bsb: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

occurrences.bsb: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

occurrences.bsb: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
occurrences.kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
occurrences.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

occurrences.bsb: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
occurrences.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

occurrences.bsb: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
occurrences.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

occurrences.bsb: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
occurrences.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

occurrences.bsb: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
occurrences.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

occurrences.bsb: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
occurrences.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

occurrences.bsb: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

occurrences.bsb: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
occurrences.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.

occurrences.bsb: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
occurrences.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

occurrences.bsb: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
occurrences.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

occurrences.bsb: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
occurrences.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

occurrences.bsb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
occurrences.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

occurrences.bsb: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
occurrences.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

occurrences.bsb: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
occurrences.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

occurrences.bsb: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
occurrences.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

occurrences.bsb: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
occurrences.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

occurrences.bsb: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
occurrences.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

occurrences.bsb: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
occurrences.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

occurrences.bsb: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.
occurrences.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

occurrences.bsb: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

occurrences.bsb: Do everything in love.
occurrences.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.

occurrences.bsb: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
occurrences.kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

occurrences.bsb: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
occurrences.kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

occurrences.bsb: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

occurrences.bsb: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
occurrences.kjv: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

occurrences.bsb: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be grieved by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
occurrences.kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

occurrences.bsb: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
occurrences.kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

occurrences.bsb: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
occurrences.kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

occurrences.bsb: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

occurrences.bsb: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

occurrences.bsb: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
occurrences.kjv: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

occurrences.bsb: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
occurrences.kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

occurrences.bsb: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow, to the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
occurrences.kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
occurrences.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

occurrences.bsb: And He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.
occurrences.kjv: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

occurrences.bsb: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
occurrences.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

occurrences.bsb: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
occurrences.kjv: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

occurrences.bsb: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
occurrences.kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
occurrences.kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

occurrences.bsb: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.
occurrences.kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

occurrences.bsb: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
occurrences.kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

occurrences.bsb: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
occurrences.kjv: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

occurrences.bsb: On account of this, we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
occurrences.kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

occurrences.bsb: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
occurrences.kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

occurrences.bsb: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
occurrences.kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

occurrences.bsb: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you—see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

occurrences.bsb: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.
occurrences.kjv: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

occurrences.bsb: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
occurrences.kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

occurrences.bsb: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will produce thanksgiving to God.
occurrences.kjv: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

occurrences.bsb: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
occurrences.kjv: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

occurrences.bsb: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
occurrences.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.
occurrences.kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

occurrences.bsb: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.
occurrences.kjv: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

occurrences.bsb: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
occurrences.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

occurrences.bsb: The marks of a true apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.
occurrences.kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

occurrences.bsb: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
occurrences.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

occurrences.bsb: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
occurrences.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

occurrences.bsb: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
occurrences.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

occurrences.bsb: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
occurrences.kjv: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

occurrences.bsb: All the saints send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: All the saints salute you.

occurrences.bsb: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:
occurrences.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

occurrences.bsb: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, “If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”
occurrences.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

occurrences.bsb: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

occurrences.bsb: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”
occurrences.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

occurrences.bsb: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
occurrences.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

occurrences.bsb: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
occurrences.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

occurrences.bsb: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
occurrences.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

occurrences.bsb: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
occurrences.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

occurrences.bsb: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
occurrences.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

occurrences.bsb: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
occurrences.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
occurrences.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
occurrences.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

occurrences.bsb: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
occurrences.kjv: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

occurrences.bsb: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

occurrences.bsb: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
occurrences.kjv: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

occurrences.bsb: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
occurrences.kjv: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

occurrences.bsb: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
occurrences.kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

occurrences.bsb: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
occurrences.kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

occurrences.bsb: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
occurrences.kjv: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

occurrences.bsb: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
occurrences.kjv: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
occurrences.kjv: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

occurrences.bsb: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
occurrences.kjv: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

occurrences.bsb: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
occurrences.kjv: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

occurrences.bsb: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
occurrences.kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

occurrences.bsb: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
occurrences.kjv: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

occurrences.bsb: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
occurrences.kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

occurrences.bsb: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
occurrences.kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

occurrences.bsb: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
occurrences.kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

occurrences.bsb: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
occurrences.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

occurrences.bsb: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
occurrences.kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

occurrences.bsb: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
occurrences.kjv: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

occurrences.bsb: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
occurrences.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

occurrences.bsb: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
occurrences.kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

occurrences.bsb: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
occurrences.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

occurrences.bsb: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
occurrences.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

occurrences.bsb: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
occurrences.kjv: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

occurrences.bsb: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
occurrences.kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

occurrences.bsb: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

occurrences.bsb: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

occurrences.bsb: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

occurrences.bsb: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
occurrences.kjv: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

occurrences.bsb: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
occurrences.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

occurrences.bsb: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.

occurrences.bsb: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
occurrences.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

occurrences.bsb: I thank my God every time I remember you.
occurrences.kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

occurrences.bsb: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
occurrences.kjv: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

occurrences.bsb: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
occurrences.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

occurrences.bsb: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
occurrences.kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

occurrences.bsb: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
occurrences.kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

occurrences.bsb: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
occurrences.kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

occurrences.bsb: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
occurrences.kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

occurrences.bsb: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
occurrences.kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

occurrences.bsb: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
occurrences.kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

occurrences.bsb: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
occurrences.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

occurrences.bsb: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
occurrences.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

occurrences.bsb: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

occurrences.bsb: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.

occurrences.bsb: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
occurrences.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

occurrences.bsb: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
occurrences.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

occurrences.bsb: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
occurrences.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

occurrences.bsb: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
occurrences.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

occurrences.bsb: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
occurrences.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

occurrences.bsb: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
occurrences.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

occurrences.bsb: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. In any and every situation I have learned the secret of being filled and being hungry, of having plenty and having need.
occurrences.kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

occurrences.bsb: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
occurrences.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

occurrences.bsb: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
occurrences.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

occurrences.bsb: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

occurrences.bsb: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
occurrences.kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cesar’s household.

occurrences.bsb: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
occurrences.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

occurrences.bsb: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
occurrences.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
occurrences.kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

occurrences.bsb: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
occurrences.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

occurrences.bsb: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully
occurrences.kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

occurrences.bsb: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
occurrences.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

occurrences.bsb: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.
occurrences.kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

occurrences.bsb: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
occurrences.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

occurrences.bsb: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
occurrences.kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

occurrences.bsb: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
occurrences.kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

occurrences.bsb: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
occurrences.kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
occurrences.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

occurrences.bsb: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
occurrences.kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

occurrences.bsb: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.
occurrences.kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

occurrences.bsb: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
occurrences.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

occurrences.bsb: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
occurrences.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

occurrences.bsb: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
occurrences.kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

occurrences.bsb: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
occurrences.kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

occurrences.bsb: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
occurrences.kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

occurrences.bsb: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
occurrences.kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

occurrences.bsb: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
occurrences.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

occurrences.bsb: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
occurrences.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

occurrences.bsb: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

occurrences.bsb: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
occurrences.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

occurrences.bsb: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.
occurrences.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

occurrences.bsb: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
occurrences.kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

occurrences.bsb: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
occurrences.kjv: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

occurrences.bsb: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
occurrences.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

occurrences.bsb: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
occurrences.kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

occurrences.bsb: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
occurrences.kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
