occurrences.bsb: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

occurrences.bsb: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

occurrences.bsb: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
occurrences.kjv: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

occurrences.bsb: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
occurrences.kjv: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

occurrences.bsb: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

occurrences.bsb: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
occurrences.kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

occurrences.bsb: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
occurrences.kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

occurrences.bsb: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

occurrences.bsb: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
occurrences.kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

occurrences.bsb: Abstain from every form of evil.
occurrences.kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

occurrences.bsb: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
occurrences.kjv: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
occurrences.kjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

occurrences.bsb: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
occurrences.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

occurrences.bsb: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
occurrences.kjv: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

occurrences.bsb: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
occurrences.kjv: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

occurrences.bsb: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

occurrences.bsb: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
occurrences.kjv: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

occurrences.bsb: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
occurrences.kjv: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

occurrences.bsb: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
occurrences.kjv: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

occurrences.bsb: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

occurrences.bsb: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
occurrences.kjv: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

occurrences.bsb: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
occurrences.kjv: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

occurrences.bsb: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
occurrences.kjv: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

occurrences.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
occurrences.kjv: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

occurrences.bsb: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

occurrences.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
occurrences.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

occurrences.bsb: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
occurrences.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

occurrences.bsb: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
occurrences.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

occurrences.bsb: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
occurrences.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
occurrences.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

occurrences.bsb: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
occurrences.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

occurrences.bsb: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
occurrences.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
occurrences.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

occurrences.bsb: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
occurrences.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

occurrences.bsb: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
occurrences.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

occurrences.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
occurrences.kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

occurrences.bsb: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
occurrences.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

occurrences.bsb: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
occurrences.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

occurrences.bsb: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
occurrences.kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

occurrences.bsb: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
occurrences.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

occurrences.bsb: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
occurrences.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

occurrences.bsb: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
occurrences.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

occurrences.bsb: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
occurrences.kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
occurrences.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

occurrences.bsb: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
occurrences.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

occurrences.bsb: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
occurrences.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

occurrences.bsb: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
occurrences.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
occurrences.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

occurrences.bsb: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
occurrences.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

occurrences.bsb: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
occurrences.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

occurrences.bsb: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
occurrences.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

occurrences.bsb: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
occurrences.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

occurrences.bsb: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
occurrences.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

occurrences.bsb: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
occurrences.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

occurrences.bsb: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
occurrences.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

occurrences.bsb: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
occurrences.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

occurrences.bsb: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
occurrences.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

occurrences.bsb: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
occurrences.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
occurrences.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

occurrences.bsb: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
occurrences.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

occurrences.bsb: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
occurrences.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

occurrences.bsb: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
occurrences.kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

occurrences.bsb: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
occurrences.kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

occurrences.bsb: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
occurrences.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

occurrences.bsb: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
occurrences.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

occurrences.bsb: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
occurrences.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

occurrences.bsb: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
occurrences.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

occurrences.bsb: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
occurrences.kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

occurrences.bsb: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
occurrences.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

occurrences.bsb: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.

occurrences.bsb: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
occurrences.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

occurrences.bsb: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.
occurrences.kjv: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

occurrences.bsb: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
occurrences.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

occurrences.bsb: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

occurrences.bsb: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
occurrences.kjv: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

occurrences.bsb: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
occurrences.kjv: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

occurrences.bsb: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,
occurrences.kjv: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

occurrences.bsb: and placed everything under his feet.” When God subjected all things to him, He left nothing outside of his control. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

occurrences.bsb: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
occurrences.kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

occurrences.bsb: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
occurrences.kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

occurrences.bsb: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
occurrences.kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

occurrences.bsb: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
occurrences.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

occurrences.bsb: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
occurrences.kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

occurrences.bsb: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
occurrences.kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

occurrences.bsb: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
occurrences.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

occurrences.bsb: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
occurrences.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

occurrences.bsb: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
occurrences.kjv: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

occurrences.bsb: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
occurrences.kjv: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

occurrences.bsb: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
occurrences.kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

occurrences.bsb: And having been made perfect, He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him
occurrences.kjv: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

occurrences.bsb: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

occurrences.bsb: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.
occurrences.kjv: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

occurrences.bsb: and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”
occurrences.kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

occurrences.bsb: And indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.
occurrences.kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

occurrences.bsb: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
occurrences.kjv: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

occurrences.bsb: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”
occurrences.kjv: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

occurrences.bsb: No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

occurrences.bsb: When everything had been prepared in this way, the priests entered regularly into the first room to perform their sacred duties.
occurrences.kjv: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

occurrences.bsb: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,
occurrences.kjv: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

occurrences.bsb: According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
occurrences.kjv: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

occurrences.bsb: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
occurrences.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

occurrences.bsb: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
occurrences.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

occurrences.bsb: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
occurrences.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
occurrences.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

occurrences.bsb: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

occurrences.bsb: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
occurrences.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

occurrences.bsb: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
occurrences.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

occurrences.bsb: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
occurrences.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

occurrences.bsb: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
occurrences.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

occurrences.bsb: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
occurrences.kjv: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

occurrences.bsb: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.
occurrences.kjv: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

occurrences.bsb: Grace be with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with you all. Amen. Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.

occurrences.bsb: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
occurrences.kjv: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

occurrences.bsb: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
occurrences.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

occurrences.bsb: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
occurrences.kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

occurrences.bsb: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
occurrences.kjv: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

occurrences.bsb: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

occurrences.bsb: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
occurrences.kjv: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:

occurrences.bsb: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
occurrences.kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

occurrences.bsb: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
occurrences.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

occurrences.bsb: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
occurrences.kjv: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

occurrences.bsb: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
occurrences.kjv: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

occurrences.bsb: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
occurrences.kjv: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

occurrences.bsb: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

occurrences.bsb: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
occurrences.kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

occurrences.bsb: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
occurrences.kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

occurrences.bsb: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
occurrences.kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

occurrences.bsb: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
occurrences.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

occurrences.bsb: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
occurrences.kjv: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

occurrences.bsb: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
occurrences.kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

occurrences.bsb: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
occurrences.kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

occurrences.bsb: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
occurrences.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

occurrences.bsb: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
occurrences.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

occurrences.bsb: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
occurrences.kjv: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

occurrences.bsb: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

occurrences.bsb: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

occurrences.bsb: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
occurrences.kjv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

occurrences.bsb: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
occurrences.kjv: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

occurrences.bsb: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
occurrences.kjv: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

occurrences.bsb: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
occurrences.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

occurrences.bsb: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
occurrences.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

occurrences.bsb: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
occurrences.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

occurrences.bsb: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
occurrences.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

occurrences.bsb: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

occurrences.bsb: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
occurrences.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

occurrences.bsb: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
occurrences.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

occurrences.bsb: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
occurrences.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

occurrences.bsb: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
occurrences.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

occurrences.bsb: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

occurrences.bsb: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
occurrences.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

occurrences.bsb: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
occurrences.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

occurrences.bsb: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
occurrences.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

occurrences.bsb: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
occurrences.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

occurrences.bsb: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
occurrences.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

occurrences.bsb: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
occurrences.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

occurrences.bsb: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
occurrences.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

occurrences.bsb: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
occurrences.kjv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

occurrences.bsb: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
occurrences.kjv: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

occurrences.bsb: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you that after Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.
occurrences.kjv: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

occurrences.bsb: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
occurrences.kjv: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

occurrences.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

occurrences.bsb: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
occurrences.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

occurrences.bsb: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
occurrences.kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
occurrences.kjv: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

occurrences.bsb: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
occurrences.kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

occurrences.bsb: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.
occurrences.kjv: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:
occurrences.kjv: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
occurrences.kjv: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

occurrences.bsb: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,
occurrences.kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

occurrences.bsb: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
occurrences.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

occurrences.bsb: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”
occurrences.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

occurrences.bsb: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
occurrences.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

occurrences.bsb: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
occurrences.kjv: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

occurrences.bsb: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
occurrences.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

occurrences.bsb: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
occurrences.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

occurrences.bsb: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
occurrences.kjv: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.

occurrences.bsb: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
occurrences.kjv: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

occurrences.bsb: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
occurrences.kjv: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

occurrences.bsb: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
occurrences.kjv: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

occurrences.bsb: And the second beast required all people, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
occurrences.kjv: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

occurrences.bsb: Then a second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
occurrences.kjv: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

occurrences.bsb: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
occurrences.kjv: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

occurrences.bsb: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died.
occurrences.kjv: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.

occurrences.bsb: Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.
occurrences.kjv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

occurrences.bsb: And he cried out in a mighty voice: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird, and every detestable beast.
occurrences.kjv: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

occurrences.bsb: All the nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality. The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown wealthy from the extravagance of her luxury.”
occurrences.kjv: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

occurrences.bsb: cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; of fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; of all kinds of citron wood and every article of ivory, precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
occurrences.kjv: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

occurrences.bsb: And they will say: “The fruit of your soul’s desire has departed from you; all your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be seen again.”
occurrences.kjv: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.

occurrences.bsb: For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!” Every shipmaster, passenger, and sailor, and all who make their living from the sea, will stand at a distance
occurrences.kjv: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

occurrences.bsb: Then they will throw dust on their heads as they weep and mourn and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.”
occurrences.kjv: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

occurrences.bsb: And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.
occurrences.kjv: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

occurrences.bsb: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
occurrences.kjv: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

occurrences.bsb: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”
occurrences.kjv: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
occurrences.kjv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

occurrences.bsb: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.”
occurrences.kjv: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.

occurrences.bsb: And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse. And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
occurrences.kjv: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

occurrences.bsb: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
occurrences.kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

occurrences.bsb: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
occurrences.kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

occurrences.bsb: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.”
occurrences.kjv: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

occurrences.bsb: The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone: The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
occurrences.kjv: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

occurrences.bsb: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

occurrences.bsb: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

occurrences.bsb: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
occurrences.kjv: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

occurrences.bsb: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
occurrences.kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

occurrences.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
